Automated Drop-off Recovery Logic

  • Reminder 1 (15 Minutes): If contact captured but no slot selected, sends a polite link to choose an appointment.
  • Reminder 2 (24 Hours): If checkout abandoned, reminds patient of the ₹800 prepaid consultation option (Save 20%).
  • Reminder 3 (72 Hours): Final neutral reminder before archiving inactive enquiries.
  • Opt-Out Enforcement: Any patient who replies "STOP" is immediately flagged as opted-out; all automated sequences stop permanently.
